confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Chinese inland tier-1 cities, not checked against live listings or current menus. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation and drink prices. The FX value comes from a search summary attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page; I did not read the RBA table directly, so verify it before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on comparable inland Chinese tier-1 cities such as Chengdu, Wuhan and Xi'an, adjusted to Chongqing's typical local price levels. No specific listings were consulted.
